title: What Lies Beyond The Fields Medal? | Science
abstract: The International Congress of Mathematicians (ICM), a quadrennial conference dating back to the 19th century, kicks off today in Philadelphia, PA, USA. Mathematicians are only eligible for the Fields Medal until the year they turn 40. Why is mathematics' highest honor reserved exclusively for the young?
tldr: This article discusses the age limit and significance of the Fields Medal in mathematics.
motivation: To explore why the Fields Medal is restricted to mathematicians under 40 and how it compares to other major awards.
method: The article is a journalistic piece, likely based on historical context and interviews, but no specific methodology is described.
